description: This map presents a false-colour infrared satellite image from Spot 5 (2.5m resolution, 1/2/3 band combination), dated 2011-07-08. The imagery is sourced from CNES 2011©, distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image. It illustrates an example of wetland interpretation rules, specifically "Example 7.1" from a Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Nomenclature Guideline, focusing on an area near Umeå, Sweden. The image depicts various land cover types: dense, healthy vegetation (such as forests or active agricultural land) appears dark red, while water bodies and river channels are represented in light blue/cyan. Distinct land cover units are delineated by white lines and labelled with numeric codes. Area '312' is a large, elongated feature appearing light green and yellowish, consistent with a waterlogged area or peatbog with significant emergent wetland vegetation. Area '411', located to the south-west of '312', is a darker, more densely vegetated wetland, characteristic of inland marshes, demonstrating different types of wetlands based on their spectral signatures and structural characteristics for land cover classification (likely within a CORINE Land Cover, or CLC, framework).
